say:1:1041570401:1.text: The battle against the fallen goddess must've been so harrowing! I would've been so scared!
say:1:1041570401:1.source_cn: 与堕神的决战竟然这么艰险……真是难以想象！

say:2:1041570402:1.text: Thank you for telling me about it, Gala. I had no idea our Magister went through something so scary. I'm so glad everyone is okay now.
say:2:1041570402:1.source_cn: 谢谢你告诉我这些，加拉！否则我根本没法知道主人经历了这...
say:2:1041570402:1.male: Thank you for telling me about it, Gala. I had no idea our Magister went through something so scary. I'm so glad everyone is okay now.
say:2:1041570402:1.female: Thank you for telling me about it, Gala. I had no idea our Magister went through something so scary. I'm so glad everyone is okay now.

say:3:1041570403:1.text: Didn't Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> tell you anything about his adventures when he traveled back in time?
say:3:1041570403:1.male: Didn't Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> tell you anything about his adventures when he traveled back in time?
say:3:1041570403:1.female: Didn't Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> tell you anything about her adventures when she traveled back in time?

say:4:1041570404:1.text: Well, he told us some things... but he never went into detail. He always hides the parts that make us all worry.
say:4:1041570404:1.male: Well, he told us some things... but he never went into detail. He always hides the parts that make us all worry.
say:4:1041570404:1.female: Well, she told us some things... but she never went into detail. She always hides the parts that make us all worry.

say:5:1041570405:1.text: A familiar's job is to stick to their Magister like glue. How did Chippy and I end up so far away? We're the worst familiars ever!
say:5:1041570405:1.source_cn: 身为使魔，我和满满却没能陪在主人身边，真是失职！
say:5:1041570405:1.male: A familiar's job is to stick to their Magister like glue. How did Chippy and I end up so far away? We're the worst familiars ever!
say:5:1041570405:1.female: A familiar's job is to stick to their Magister like glue. How did Chippy and I end up so far away? We're the worst familiars ever!

say:6:1041570406:1.text: You worry too much. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is fine and completely unhurt. He made it back to you safe and sound.
say:6:1041570406:1.male: You worry too much. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is fine and completely unhurt. He made it back to you safe and sound.
say:6:1041570406:1.female: You worry too much. Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> is fine and completely unhurt. She made it back to you safe and sound.

say:7:1041570407:1.text: More than that, he helped us overcome every disaster we faced. We owe him everything. He saved the Wildborn...
say:7:1041570407:1.male: More than that, he helped us overcome every disaster we faced. We owe him everything. He saved the Wildborn...
say:7:1041570407:1.female: More than that, she helped us overcome every disaster we faced. We owe her everything. She saved the Wildborn...

say:9:1041570409:1.text: Well, he is Merlin after all. The greatest mage in all of history!
say:9:1041570409:1.male: Well, he is Merlin after all. The greatest mage in all of history!
say:9:1041570409:1.female: Well, she is Merlin after all. The greatest mage in all of history!

say:10:1041570410:1.text: Even if the first Merlin was standing in front of me, I'd still say it to her face!
say:10:1041570410:1.source_cn: 就算是初代梅林在我面前，我一样敢说这话！

say:12:1041570412:1.text: I don't think the first Merlin would mind.
say:12:1041570412:1.source_cn: 而且梅林……不，初代梅林，她不会介意的。

say:13:1041570413:1.text: Is it just me, or does it seem like world-ending events keep finding the Magister? It's like he can't even go out for a cupcake without a time portal opening up.
say:13:1041570413:1.source_cn: 说起来，你觉不觉得，无论主人走到哪里都会遭遇亟待解决的...

say:14:1041570414:1.text: Is this why people always say "with great power comes great responsibility"?
say:14:1041570414:1.source_cn: 难道这就是所谓的“能力越大，责任越大”？

say:15:1041570415:1.text: Has Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> been involved in a lot of world-ending events?
say:15:1041570415:1.male: Has Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> been involved in a lot of world-ending events?
say:15:1041570415:1.female: Has Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> been involved in a lot of world-ending events?

say:16:1041570416:1.text: Okay, maybe the world didn't literally end, but he saved a lot of places! There was the whole Ryeham mess, the infighting of Dark Forest, the trials in the Ashen Wastes, then Rustport, Whiteridge... So many deeds, so many stories...
say:16:1041570416:1.source_cn: 当然啦！在金穗村、薄暮丛林、荒角沙漠、锈锚港、白山公国...
say:16:1041570416:1.male: Okay, maybe the world didn't literally end, but he saved a lot of places! There was the whole Ryeham mess, the infighting of Dark Forest, the trials in the Ashen Wastes, then Rustport, Whiteridge... So many deeds, so many stories...
say:16:1041570416:1.female: Okay, maybe the world didn't literally end, but she saved a lot of places! There was the whole Ryeham mess, the infighting of Dark Forest, the trials in the Ashen Wastes, then Rustport, Whiteridge... So many deeds, so many stories...

say:17:1041570417:1.text: The Magister once went to Brimstone Village to investigate a dwarven conspiracy, and ended up saving the city of Sal'thorin and rescuing the Primordial Dragon.
say:17:1041570417:1.source_cn: 就比如主人曾经前往深岩村调查矮人暗中密谋之事，顺便解救...
say:17:1041570417:1.male: The Magister once went to Brimstone Village to investigate a dwarven conspiracy, and ended up saving the city of Sal'thorin and rescuing the Primordial Dragon.
say:17:1041570417:1.female: The Magister once went to Brimstone Village to investigate a dwarven conspiracy, and ended up saving the city of Sal'thorin and rescuing the Primordial Dragon.

say:18:1041570418:1.text: Honestly, the stories people tell don't even do him justice. Our Magister is a living legend, and I won't hear otherwise!
say:18:1041570418:1.male: Honestly, the stories people tell don't even do him justice. Our Magister is a living legend, and I won't hear otherwise!
say:18:1041570418:1.female: Honestly, the stories people tell don't even do her justice. Our Magister is a living legend, and I won't hear otherwise!

say:20:1041570420:1.text: Oh, sorry. Maybe I got a little carried away. I always get a bit excited whenever I talk about him. I hope I didn't scare you.
say:20:1041570420:1.source_cn: 啊……抱歉，我一讲起主人的故事就有点激动，是不是吓到你了？
say:20:1041570420:1.male: Oh, sorry. Maybe I got a little carried away. I always get a bit excited whenever I talk about him. I hope I didn't scare you.
say:20:1041570420:1.female: Oh, sorry. Maybe I got a little carried away. I always get a bit excited whenever I talk about her. I hope I didn't scare you.

say:22:1041570422:1.text: Hammie, please tell me more about Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I want to hear everything.
say:22:1041570422:1.source_cn: 漫漫，请再给我多讲一些有关<style=stress>...
say:22:1041570422:1.male: Hammie, please tell me more about Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I want to hear everything.
say:22:1041570422:1.female: Hammie, please tell me more about Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I want to hear everything.

say:23:1041570423:1.text: Listening to your tales, it's like I was right there in the thick of it, fighting alongside you all.
say:23:1041570423:1.source_cn: 听过你讲述的故事，就好像我也和<male>他</mal...
say:23:1041570423:1.male: Listening to your tales, it's like I was right there in the thick of it, fighting alongside you all.
say:23:1041570423:1.female: Listening to your tales, it's like I was right there in the thick of it, fighting alongside you all.
